data.body: Verification nuance: the ticket-stored shell-comment-only command uses escaped BRE grouping (\\(...\\|...\\)) with git diff --ignore-matching-lines, whose regex is ERE; the literal command therefore returns rc=1 and prints the comment-only diff. The semantically identical ERE form ^([[:space:]]*#[^!].*|[[:space:]]*#[[:space:]]*|[[:space:]]*;.*|[[:space:]]*<!--.*|[[:space:]]*.*-->|[[:space:]]*)$ returns rc=0 on 4672bfe^..4672bfe. An independent changed-line audit also found zero added or removed executable shell lines. Signed ticket material was not edited, avoiding an unnecessary plan-review invalidation.
